congo-dr.title: Flag of the Democratic Republic of the Congo

colors.note: Diagonal stripe and star symbolising the country's wealth and a shining future.
Narrow diagonal bands alongside the yellow stripe, evoking the blood of the country's martyrs.

desc:
- A sky-blue field crossed from lower hoist to upper fly by a yellow diagonal stripe edged in red
- A large yellow five-pointed star sits in the upper hoist corner
- Adopted on 20 February 2006 after the transitional government, closely reviving the 1963-1971 flag
trivia:
- The current flag is a lighter-blue revival of the independence-era flag flown from 1963 to 1971
- Under Mobutu's Zaire (1971-1997), the country flew a green flag with a torch-bearing arm
- Laurent Kabila's 1997-2006 flag used a darker blue; the shade was brightened on readoption
